subject.title: Add loop-aware compaction guard for saturated sessions

question: Should OpenClaw core own a broad saturated-session compaction guard under agents.defaults.compaction.guard, and what default/config/reset-recommendation policy should it use?
rationale: The remaining work adds public config/default semantics and may recommend session resets, which affects existing session behavior and cannot be safely chosen from source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep canonical design thread
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the guard contract, reconcile related compaction work, and require live or sanitized fixture proof before runtime implementation.

options.title: Narrow to existing guardrails
options.body: Limit core work to the shipped tools.loopDetection.postCompactionGuard plus separate rate-limit or Codex-continuity issues, and close or split the broader guard proposal later.

options.title: Sponsor config PR first
options.body: Review the open config-scaffold PR as an explicit product direction step, accepting that it creates a public config surface before detector/runtime proof exists.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical design thread
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the guard contract, reconcile related compaction work, and require live or sanitized fixture proof before runtime implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and maintained the adjacent post-compaction guard and already made the related loop-detection default policy call.
